amy (devex): FYI I opened a small docs PR with migration examples and a short troubleshooting section for function/tool calling and structured output: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512

ross (eng): Checking. Are we changing server payloads or just docs? Need to be clear about breaking changes.

amy (devex): Docs only — runtime already uses `tool_call`. This PR explains the canonical shape, shows how to handle older `tool` keys, and adds parse/fallback examples for Python/JS/Go.

tess (ml): Add explicit examples showing both success (JSON-encoded `arguments`) and failure (plain text) and how to handle each. Many teams assume SDK auto-parses.

claire (docs): Agreed. I added a one-sentence guardrail: \"Prefer `arguments` as a JSON-encoded string and always validate it with a JSON Schema before invoking external tools.\" Kept it short.

ross (eng): Can you add a repo-wide migration one-liner? People will grep/replace.

amy (devex): Proposed safe replacement examples in the PR: a `perl -pi.bak` example and a `git grep | xargs sed -n` example. Also added a sample unit test that asserts parser handles both structured and free-form responses.

tess (ml): For the schema, suggest this compact snippet so it's copy-paste friendly: {\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"tool_call\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"name\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"arguments\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"name\",\"arguments\"]}}}

claire (docs): I also added short SDK snippets. Node explicitly shows `JSON.parse(args)` in a try/catch. Python example shows `json.loads` with fallback to a `_raw` field. Go snippet uses `json.Unmarshal` and falls back to map with `_raw`.

ross (eng): Tiny nit: emphasize \"callers must parse\" — do not imply the SDK auto-parses.

amy (devex): Updated wording to \"callers should parse and validate\".

tess (ml): Add an \"advanced\" paragraph with a heuristic normalizer for common issues (single quotes, trailing commas) but clearly label it as lossy and not recommended for critical data.

claire (docs): Done. Short paragraph and example code. Marked advanced.

bot-ci: label added: area:structured-output, pr:needs-review · preview: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/512

ross (eng): Looks good. One more ask: include a one-line changelog entry so customers subscribing to notes see the shape standardization.

amy (devex): Added changelog PR entry and cross-linked the migration guide page under /docs/migration/shape-changes.

tess (ml): Also suggest adding a tiny regression test to the docs repo tests that runs the parser on both `{\"tool_call\":{\"name\":\"x\",\"arguments\":\"{\\\"k\\\":1}\"}}` and `\"please do X\"`. Saves future headaches.

amy (devex): Good call. Added the test snippet. Merging after CI.

bot-ci: checks/presubmit: success · live-preview: queued

amy (devex): CI passed and I merged. Thanks all. Reopen if anything slips through after release. :)
